import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', order=['Basic', '2n Cycle', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD'])
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Education Level')
ax1.set_ylabel('Income ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Total spending by product category
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = df[spending_cols].sum()
categories = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
bars = ax2.bar(categories, spending_totals.values)
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Product Category')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Amount Spent')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 5000,
             f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Purchase channels distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
purchase_totals = df[purchase_cols].sum()
channels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(channels)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(purchase_totals.values, labels=channels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Purchase Distribution by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Customer age distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
current_year = 2024
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']
ax4.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.axvline(df['Age'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {df["Age"].mean():.1f}')
ax4.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Customers')
ax4.legend()

# 5. Income vs. Total Spending
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['Income'], df['Total_Spending'], alpha=0.6, c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=30)
ax5.set_title('Income vs. Total Spending', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Income ($)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Age')

# 6. Family composition
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
family_counts = df['Total_Children'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax6.bar(family_counts.index.astype(str), family_counts.values)
ax6.set_title('Family Composition (Number of Children)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Children')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Customers')
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 10,
             f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom')

# 7. Campaign acceptance rates
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_names = ['Campaign 1', 'Campaign 2', 'Campaign 3', 'Campaign 4', 'Campaign 5', 'Latest Campaign']
acceptance_rates = [df[col].mean() * 100 for col in campaign_cols]
bars = ax7.bar(campaign_names, acceptance_rates)
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Campaign')
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax7.set_ylim(0, max(acceptance_rates) * 1.2)
for bar, rate in zip(bars, acceptance_rates):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax7.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'{rate:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 8. Recency distribution
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Recency', bins=30, kde=True, ax=ax8)
ax8.set_title('Days Since Last Purchase (Recency)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Days Since Last Purchase')
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Customers')

# 9. Web visits vs. web purchases
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='NumWebVisitsMonth', y='NumWebPurchases', alpha=0.6, ax=ax9)
ax9.set_title('Web Visits vs. Web Purchases', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Monthly Web Visits')
ax9.set_ylabel('Web Purchases')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
